Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a business and occupation tax deduction for reimbursements for immunizing agents.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a business and occupation tax deduction forreimbursements for immunizing agents; and adding a new section tochapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing tax there may be deducted from the measure of taxamounts received by health care providers as reimbursements forimmunizing agents, not to exceed the then current federal rate.Amounts received by health care providers for the administration ofimmunizing agents are not deductible under this section. (2) The definitions in this subsection apply to this section. (a) "Federal rate" means the rate at or below which the federalgovernment or its agents reimburse providers for vaccines and otherimmunologic drugs as provided for in the medicare, part B, drugsaverage sales price information resource as published by the UnitedStates department of health and human services, or any successor indexthereto. p. 1 HB 3313 (b) "Health care provider" has the meaning provided in RCW70.02.010. (c) "Immunizing agent" means any vaccine or other immunologic druglicensed and approved by the United States food and drugadministration, or meeting World Health Organization requirements, forimmunization of persons against vaccinepreventable diseases.
